about: Reusable blocks of the editorial-select hand, in film order. Each is library/<name>.html (CONTRACT.md) with library/<name>.md and carries the shared runtime (library/_runtime). Every block has a general mode (any words, any images, any format, fonts and colours from tokens or props) and a replica mode (preset plus props.replica from ~/motion-expert/work/replica/presets, outside the skill). Plan new pieces from this list and templates/film-arc.json first and from the grammar second.

genre-word-card.name: genre-word-card
genre-word-card.what: A run of hard-cut cards: one serif word centred between four selection-handle chips over a full-bleed picture; on each cut the picture and word change together, the letters snap from crowded or spread to their set spacing over six frames, and the handles glide to the new word's box with a segmented streak. Optional step-up nests a second handle set on a bigger word. Steps on the 16 fps cadence.

select-handles.name: select-handles
select-handles.what: The four-chip selection, reusable around any element: chips on a box's corners glide to the next box on the snap ease (from a frame early) as segmented streaks turned along the path, jump to a bigger box while the old set lingers three frames, pop with a landing size, or collapse inward. Every glide is sampled on the 16 fps cadence. The engine is window.__esRuntime.select, shared with any block that draws a selection.

tile-scatter.name: tile-scatter
tile-scatter.what: Grid paper fills with picture tiles that pop and drift into whole cells and lowercase serif words that land one per beat on paper cards and walk a cell at a time; then the cards cut to one centred line that swells while the grid grows and the tiles drop out a few per picture. Steps on the 16 fps cadence.

lockup-scramble.name: lockup-scramble
lockup-scramble.what: One serif line turns into the next by losing letters at random while the new line's letters arrive in place in the incoming colour; the finished line turns ink, holds with a barely visible breathing scale, then its tail changes face on every second picture while the line steps up in size towards the frame edge.

icon-tile.name: icon-tile
icon-tile.what: A violet tile carrying a mark slot arrives on paper with a slow push: notches, mark faint then white then black, a one-frame step to twice the size, four handle chips arriving per corner, gliding out, pressed and pulled in, out again; fade step; carried off by the accelerating camera pan.

giant-type-pass.name: giant-type-pass
giant-type-pass.what: A giant serif line rushes past: the first word rises from below on an exponential ease-out under the accelerating camera pan, later words rise in behind it, and as a picture blooms in behind the type the letters turn black to white along a soft 20 degree edge sweeping left to right.
